note: Head-mounted Project Aria IMU only (no video/audio/gaze). One IMU per take, imu-right (1202-1, ~800 Hz) preferred over imu-left (1202-2, ~1 kHz). Accel m/s^2 -> g with gravity present; gyro rad/s; Aria device frame. Anti-aliased (zero-phase FIR, 80 Hz passband) and resampled onto a uniform 200 Hz grid, because the frontend's f_max is ~14 Hz and native-rate storage would cost 4-5x for content the model never reads. Sessions split at IMU gaps > 0.5 s rather than interpolating across dropouts; parts keep 'aria_head' as a matchable substring. Subject id is p<participant_uid> from takes.json, falling back to the capture uid when absent (see manifest.json: subject_id_source). Label-free: every session carries the reserved marker __unlabeled__; Phase-A self-supervision only, never a Phase-B evidence-bank source. Licence-gated (https://ego4d-data.org/, ~2 day approval). This file is the static descriptor; convert.py rewrites it with the realized subject/stream counts.
